newsitem.title: USA: Gencorp buys Morton pigment business.
newsitem.headline: Gencorp buys Morton pigment business.

text.p: GenCorp said on Monday that its Specialty Polymers Division had bought the Lytron polystyrene latex plastic pigment business of Morton International Inc.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Under the agreement, GenCorp bought the Lytron brand name, technology, customer base and certain other assets.

GenCorp said the purchase is the first step in a continuing move to strengthen and broaden its emulsion polymer business, which the company identified as a key growth platform to generate enhanced value for its customers and shareholders. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
